issues.description: Console logs show repeated 500 Internal Server Error for a resource (likely an API call or asset) during earlier auth page visits. The step-1 page itself loaded without page errors, but the 500 errors may indicate a backend issue that could affect functionality.
issues.root_cause: A server-side API route or resource is returning 500. This is not visible in the UI but appears in console logs. The step-1 page mounted successfully without errors.

issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' This suggests a scroll-related component (likely a scroll-tracking or parallax element) has a statically positioned container.
issues.root_cause: A component using a scroll offset library (possibly framer-motion useScroll or a custom hook) does not have position: relative on its container element.
